# CLAUDE.md

Aeronautica: The Wandering City -- a Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge 47.4.10 modpack
(Create/Valkyrien Skies/Eureka/Clockwork/Ad Astra progression). This file is
for coding agents; see `README.md` for the player-facing description and
`TESTING.md` for the full testing reference.

## Source of truth / generated files

- `modpack/manifest.json` -- **human-edited** source of truth. `mods[]` is
  what a contributor adds; `resolved_mods[]` is generated by
  `scripts/validate.py` (transitive Modrinth dependency resolution +
  hashes). Never hand-edit `resolved_mods`.
- `modpack/modrinth.index.json` -- **fully generated** from
  `manifest.json` by `scripts/validate.py`. Never edit directly; never treat
  it as a second source of truth.
- `releases/*.mrpack`, `releases/*-manual.zip`, `releases/SHA256SUMS` --
  build output, gitignored, regenerated by `scripts/validate.py --build`.

## Invariants (do not violate without an explicit, deliberate decision)

- Minecraft 1.20.1, Forge 47.4.10, Java 17 -- pinned everywhere (manifest,
  validator, every test suite, every workflow). See TESTING.md "why Java 17
  and Forge 47.4.10 are pinned".
- Clockwork / Valkyrien Skies / Eureka are version-sensitive together and
  must not be bumped independently -- the rule is enforced in
  `scripts/aeronautica_testing/compat.py` (imported by both
  `scripts/validate.py` and the test suites). Add new cross-mod rules there,
  not ad hoc.
- FTB Quests/Library/Teams are intentionally absent (unverifiable Modrinth
  identities at the time this was decided) -- do not reintroduce them
  without verifying real project IDs/versions/hashes first.
- Never guess a Modrinth project ID, version, download URL, hash, or
  license. Resolve it from the live API or from the actual downloaded jar
  (see `scripts/aeronautica_testing/tools/extract_registry_facts.py` for
  the pattern: derive facts from the real artifact, never hand-type them).
- Never hard-code the mod count anywhere; derive it from the built
  `modrinth.index.json`.
- Test-only tooling (GameTest QA mod, HeadlessMC's MC-Runtime-Test helper,
  Chunky, spark) must never appear in `releases/*.mrpack` or the manual
  ZIP. `scripts/aeronautica_testing/mrpack_validate.py`'s
  `check_no_test_artifacts` enforces this on every build.

## Testing

One command surface, shared by local dev and CI -- see `TESTING.md` for the
full reference:

```bash
python scripts/test_pipeline.py <prereqs|fast|artifact|client|server|gametest|worldgen|full>
./scripts/test.sh <suite>          # bash wrapper
.\scripts\test.ps1 <suite>         # PowerShell wrapper
```

Run `fast` before every commit (network-free, seconds). Run `artifact`
before touching `scripts/validate.py`, `manifest.json`, or the override
files. The suite implementation lives in
`scripts/aeronautica_testing/` (small, single-purpose modules -- see that
directory's files for `report.py`/`compat.py`/`mrpack_validate.py`/etc.)
and is unit-tested under `tests/unit/`.

**Known limitation**: `tests/gametest/` (Forge GameTest project) compiles
and is fully wired but does not currently pass `gradlew runGameTestServer`
in this repo's dev environment -- see TESTING.md "Known limitations" for
the confirmed root cause (a ForgeGradle userdev Mixin-refmap issue
affecting several mods including Valkyrien Skies) before spending time
re-diagnosing it from scratch.

## Working in this repo

- Preserve unrelated uncommitted changes; run `git status` before editing.
- `scripts/validate.py`'s archive writer is deterministic on purpose (fixed
  timestamp/permissions, sorted traversal) -- if you touch it, re-run
  `python scripts/test_pipeline.py artifact` to confirm the
  reproducible-build check still passes.
- Adding a mod: edit `modpack/manifest.json`'s `mods[]`, then run
  `python scripts/validate.py` (resolves + rewrites `resolved_mods`/index)
  and `python scripts/test_pipeline.py fast`.
- Adding a compatibility rule: see TESTING.md "How to add a new mod
  compatibility rule".
- Adding a GameTest: see TESTING.md "How to add a GameTest".
